sealed.statement: The Solver workflow implements the verified streamlining specification: the attempt capture excludes and names another quest's bookkeeping and scope refusals name their paths; the stall theory gate excludes verifier-demanded replacement attempts; one recorded override covers one logical run and is charged only when that run records its attempt, with every blocked commit gate reported in one pass; findings carry a fail-closed severity and monotone amendments have their own cap; the seal gate adds the silent-catch, decision-boundary, and complexity admissions and preflight --full runs the publish statics; the publish gate fails fast on a missing data/ link; the landing import-graph verify waits for load headroom; review manifests freeze the delta of a rejected round; receipts may name a TAP subtest with a zero-test guard and new can scaffold the harness; and an epoch re-pin records a covering obligation instead of a reseal.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

No honesty or integrity invariant is weakened: overrides still cover only overridable guards, a rejection still needs a defect, the sealed probe and metrics stay immutable, and every new checker only adds refusals.
